why: BASELINE. Single artist credit, no relations, unambiguous title. Today scores artist:1 like everything else; after the fix it must score artist:0. If this one does not improve, the fix did not land.
BASELINE. Second clean single-artist album, different genre/era, guards against a fix that only works for one release shape.
THE REPORTED BUG. Credit 'Barber, Bruch; Esther Yoo, ...' has the ';' joinphrase but ZERO release-level artist relations, so displayArtist must fall back to artist-credit ORDER and pick Esther Yoo.
Second composer split with a different shape (conductor, not soloist, as the performer). Confirms the ';' split is not tuned to one album.

AMBIGUITY TRAP. Dozens of 'Le quattro stagioni' releases share near-identical track titles and counts, so with the artist signal dead the matcher is choosing on title alone. Performer is the only distinguishing evidence.

Various Artists. Release credit is 'Various Artists' but every track has a different artist. Exercises isVarious/vaRE and the empty-artist search fallback; must not regress now that artist distance counts.
Multi-disc (2 media, 26 tracks). Exercises the mediums distance component and the discSegRE folding alongside a live artist signal.
Non-Latin credit. The new albumArtist correction writes the original script; latinize() must still rewrite it for display without corrupting the stored value.

SEPARATION TRAP part 1. Self-titled, so album == artist. Paired with the 2001 album below, artist distance is IDENTICAL for both, and only the tracklist separates them. Guards against the fix creating false confidence.
SEPARATION TRAP part 2. Same artist, same title, different tracklist. Must stay separated on tracks, not artist.
